passages.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.
passages.sermon:
This psalm is for the choirmaster.
The psalm uses stringed instruments.
This writing is a psalm.
This psalm is also a song.

passages.text: May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
The psalm is for the choirmaster.
The psalm is to be played with stringed instruments.
The psalm is a song.
God is the subject.
God is gracious.
God blesses us.
God causes His face to shine upon us.
Selah.
God does this so that people may know His ways on earth.
God does this so that all nations may know His salvation.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥ח בִּנְגִינֹ֗ת מִזְמ֥וֹר שִֽׁיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְחָנֵּ֥נוּ וִֽיבָרְכֵ֑נוּ יָ֤אֵ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו אִתָּ֣נוּ סֶֽלָה׃ לָדַ֣עַת בָּאָ֣רֶץ דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ בְּכָל־ גּ֝וֹיִ֗ם יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
passages.sermon: God is the one we praise.\r\nAll peoples praise God.\r\nEveryone praises God.
passages.original: יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
passages.sermon:
God is the judge of all peoples.
God judges everyone with fairness.
God leads all the nations on earth.
The nations rejoice.
The nations sing for joy.
All peoples praise God.
All peoples give thanks to God.
passages.original: יִֽשְׂמְח֥וּ וִֽירַנְּנ֗וּ לְאֻ֫מִּ֥ים כִּֽי־ תִשְׁפֹּ֣ט עַמִּ֣ים מִישׁ֑וֹר וּלְאֻמִּ֓ים׀ בָּאָ֖רֶץ תַּנְחֵ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃ יוֹד֖וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים׀ אֱלֹהִ֑ים י֝וֹד֗וּךָ עַמִּ֥ים כֻּלָּֽם׃

passages.text: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
passages.sermon: God is our God.\r\nGod blesses us.\r\nThe earth has given its harvest.
passages.original: אֶ֭רֶץ נָתְנָ֣ה יְבוּלָ֑הּ יְ֝בָרְכֵ֗נוּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

passages.text: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
passages.sermon:
God blesses us.
God is our God.
All the ends of the earth will fear Him.
God’s blessing leads people everywhere to fear Him.
passages.original: יְבָרְכֵ֥נוּ אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְיִֽירְא֥וּ אֹ֝ת֗וֹ כָּל־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
